title: Registered Nurse
description: Provide direct patient care, administer medications, monitor vital signs. BSN preferred, active RN license required.

title: Medical Assistant
description: Support clinical operations: rooming patients, taking vitals, preparing exam rooms. CMA or RMA certification preferred.

title: Patient Care Coordinator
description: Coordinate patient care plans, schedule appointments, liaise between patients and providers.

title: Clinical Coordinator
description: Oversee clinical workflows, support care team coordination, ensure compliance with healthcare standards.

title: Care Coordinator
description: Connect patients with appropriate services, conduct intake assessments, follow up on care plans.

title: Healthcare Administrator
description: Manage day-to-day operations, oversee staff, budgets, compliance. MPH or MHA preferred.

title: Medical Billing Specialist
description: Process claims, verify insurance, handle billing. Experience with EHR systems required.

title: Pharmacy Technician
description: Assist pharmacists with dispensing, inventory, patient interactions. PTCB certification preferred.

title: Medical Records Technician
description: Maintain patient records, ensure HIPAA compliance. RHIT or equivalent preferred.
